sources.note: CC BY 4.0; land extent, not timber volume or ecological condition.

limitations: Forest area is land extent, not timber volume, biodiversity, carbon stock or ownership.
Fisheries production is not a map of wild fish abundance or fishing pressure.
Capture and aquaculture are different production systems.
